comment: The Collector the packages ship: upstream's otelcol-contrib release, unchanged. internal/fetchcontrib downloads an archive and refuses it unless its SHA-256 is pinned here. Pin a new release only after cosign verify-blob passes on each archive's .sigstore.json (signer: the open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases workflows); v0.164.0's six were checked that way.
